caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a vintage baby carriage or pram centered on a plain, off-white background. The carriage features four large, spoked wheels that are light green in color. It has an elongated, curved handlebar at the left end, also painted light green, which is attached to the frame of the pram. The body of the carriage is rendered in a muted green shade with yellow highlights, and the seating area is lined with a brown, tent-like fabric canopy that covers the back and partially the sides, leaving the front open. The fabric encloses a dark interior, and some parts fold inwards, offering a sense of depth. There are thin brown structural supports holding the canopy in place. The name “W.W. Jennings” is printed in black, uppercase letters in the lower right corner of the image, just inside the drawn rectangular border that frames the main illustration.
title: Doll Carriage
